description.value: Whole-brain BOLD fMRI data were manually realigned to the AC-PC line, skull-stripped with FSL Brain Extraction Tool, and anatomically segmented and normalized with DARTEL to create a sample-specific template and individual deformation fields. Functional data were slice-timing corrected, adjusted for magnetic-field distortion using field maps, realigned to the mean functional image, coregistered with the anatomical image, normalized to MNI space, and smoothed with a 6 mm Gaussian kernel. Global signal spikes and motion outliers were identified with the Artifact Detection Toolbox; motion variables were included as regressors and flagged volumes were deweighted during individual-level model estimation.
